title: Using a robust model to detect the association between anthropometric factors and T2DM: machine learning approaches.
summary: KNN has the best reported performance and BRI/BAI/MAC or BMI/BRI/MAC are highlighted by sex. KNN, SVM, ANN and other ML models assess anthropometric predictors and T2DM association. Testing: The study evaluates multiple models and reports holdout performance, bounded to its cohort and imbalanced data.. The open-access primary article evaluates ML associations between anthropometric factors and T2DM; KNN performs best among tested models and identifies sex-specific anthropometric associations in the study cohort. Source affiliation was not stated in the reviewed case checks and was unavailable in the local bibliographic cache.
